page.overview:
Who is Ezhar I Palaigodes?

Emperor Ezhar I Palaigodes was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 553–561 AG), succeeding his father Shaddam I as ruler of the Corrino Imperium.

Ezhar ruled under the regents Harmon I al-Qair (553–556) and Kalus I al-Qair (556–561). Ezhar's reign ended in 561, when Kalus became the ruler of the Imperium as Protector, beginning the First Protectorate. The Corrino line was eventually restored to the throne with Ezhar's brother Audrii I in 603.
